top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic
top_sast_rules.description: Building a NoSQL query from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious NoSQL code by the user.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement secure coding practices specific to this vulnerability type. Review the query logic for detailed requirements.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
top_sast_rules.description: Building a SQL query from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious SQL code by the user.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements. Never build SQL queries using string operations with user input.

top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Use parameterized LDAP queries and escape special characters. Validate input format and use LDAP libraries with injection protection.
